title: 🌟 My Casino Mall Dream Turned Into an Identity Shift (All names fake, extremely vivid dream) AI image based off my dream.
content: (All names fake, extremely vivid dream) Before I start — I’ve always had hyper-real dreams. The kind where I wake up thinking they actually happened, and people have to tell me, “No… that was a dream.” My dad is the same way — we’ve even shared the same dream twice. This one felt like three separate dreams smashed into one, but somehow I can recall every part with total clarity. --- CHAPTER 1 — MANSION It begins at my old friend Anna's house. I haven’t spoken to her or her family in YEARS, yet in the dream their ages were perfectly updated to what they’d be today. The house looked modern — renovated, bright — but spiritually, I kept getting this overwhelming feeling: “This house is actually REALLY old.” Like ancient-old. As I walked through the rooms, I saw patches where the paint had peeled away, revealing dark, rotting wood, decaying corners, and old bones of a mansion trying to hide beneath fresh paint. It felt like the modern look was a mask covering something much older and aware. Her parents were acting abusive but everyone treated it like it was normal. All the kids were zipped into a giant sleeping bag hanging from the ceiling like some twisted family “game.” Then they served cow manure for breakfast. It tasted like chocolate in the dream, and I ate it just to get a moment alone. One of the twins kicked my leg twice — like a secret warning — then acted like nothing happened. Everything felt off. I fake-called my mom. My cousin Jess came to get me, her kids in the backseat. We drove around for a while, talking — and then everything shifted again. The sky suddenly turned dark grey, like a storm rolling in without warning. Not pitch black, just heavy and unnatural. And then — I wasn’t in the car anymore. I was walking. Walking forward into— --- CHAPTER 2 — GLASS TUNNEL A massive glass tunnel, glowing blue and pink. Light bouncing off every surface. The ceiling impossibly tall. Dozens of people rushed beside me, brushing past with purpose, and inside my head I thought: “This feels like an airport — everyone running to their gates.” Same frantic energy. Same organized chaos. Same feeling of being out of place in a crowd that knows exactly where it’s going. I walked through it, and when I reached the end— --- CHAPTER 3 — CHAOS I stepped into Mall World. A massive, bright, impossible casino-mall hybrid: • Daylight-bright but no sky • Huge glass dome • Birds flying around inside • Arcade lights everywhere • Casino machines chirping • Crowds PACKED shoulder-to-shoulder • Never-ending hallways • Escalators twisting like Harry Potter staircases • Tiny elevator platforms floating above the crowd • Food court signs glowing • Everything moving, flashing, buzzing And right when I arrived, Jas— someone I didn’t vibe with from school — was already there, waving me over: “Hey girl! Come on this way!” She acted like she’d been waiting for me. We walked and talked nonstop (don’t remember what about), weaving through the chaos. Less than a minute in, we found the little girl sitting on the stairs holding a doll. Her clothes were dirty, her face smudged, and her “black eye” was obviously fake makeup. She looked up and said: “Can I leave her with you, in case I don’t make it?” Meaning the doll. The doll looked normal at first… until I said: “Definitely not.” Then its face twisted into something angry, demonic, searching — like it wanted a new host. The girl looked almost disappointed. Jas kept walking. We climbed a big staircase to a platform where a giant velvet red and black treasure chest was slowly rotating. It looked heavy, luxurious, theatrical. Jas pointed at it: “You’re supposed to jump! So many people have tried. Think you can make it?” I grabbed the edge — barely — but made it. The chest rewarded me with a silver jewelry box, which I put in my burgundy hoodie pocket. There were stickers to seal it, but every single one had the logo blurred out? like censored almost. The ONLY thing I could read was: “2024” And I remember thinking: “Oh, these must be old,” which meant I KNEW what year it was inside the dream. Then panic hit me. I started worrying that mall security would think I stole the jewelry from a store. I kept checking my pocket, feeling guilty and exposed. That’s when I finally said: “Can you take me home?” Jas: “No.” “Please take me home.” “No.” She walked faster, deeper into the chaos. Then out of nowhere she said: “You’re just like Tris.” At first I thought she meant someone I knew. But when I woke up, I realized: She meant Tris from Divergent. I said: “Okay… then take me to her?” She refused again and instead took me to a giant mirror. Everything got quiet. I looked at myself — same face, same hair — but my eyes were: Bright amber-yellow. Glowing. Beautiful. Inhuman. I stared for minutes just examining and thinking: “wait my eyes aren’t yellow…” And the instant I thought that — I woke up. No fade-out. Just instant. In some twisted symbolic way, Jas did take me “home" LOL First thing I did when I woke up was check my surroundings to make sure I was awake and said "What the fuck?" Okay if this sounds like AI its because when I woke up this morning I word vomited my weird connecting dreams into chat gbt. I asked it to make digestible so I could post it here and I have a couple questions for you guys. -Has anybody encountered a demonic doll or little girl asking for help? -Does anybody else have Birds in their Casino Mall? -People in your world, is it a mix of people you used to talk to or someone you used to know but dont keep up with now? And a bunch of filler NPCs. -Have you ever looked in the mirror or been shown a mirror in your mall? Let me know! I wanna read it all!! Thanks for reading my dream 😊
